paragraphs: Amarillo A Series Fan Drives – A38/A40

The Amarillo A Series Fan Drives are designed as direct replacements for the Marley Cooling Tower line of right angle gear drives. There are no differences in the critical mounting dimensions of the A Series making gear drive replacements easy. The gear housing foot-patterns, input shaft diameters and keyways are identical so existing couplings and drive shafts do not have to be replaced.
